exposure: Antimicrobial exposure within one month prior to isolation
Hospitalization history within six months prior to isolation
outcome: Antimicrobial drug resistance (e.g., MRSA, ESBLs producing Escherichia coli)
Antimicrobial susceptibility patterns of bacterial pathogens
cohort: Surgical patients whose reports of postoperative infections and antimicrobial therapy were analyzed from January 1, 2024, to August 31, 2024.
finding: The study found that most Gram-negative isolates causing postoperative infections were multiply resistant to commonly prescribed antimicrobial agents, and a third-generation cephalosporin like Ceftriaxone was ineffective against many gram-negative organisms and MRSA isolates.
